verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm FBO deposit account structures, dashboard/API visibility into account and compliance data, and Federal Reserve connectivity, but there is no plain-language documentation of where FDIC insurance actually attaches, how ledger visibility/permissions are governed, or explicit distinction between FBO pooled vs individual account structures for compliance purposes. missing for 10: explicit FDIC pass-through insurance disclosure, ledger access/permission documentation, clear individual-vs-pooled account structure explanation.
